name: Pantala
source: Traced from the coloured Pantala plate (The Lost Continent); Poison Jungle places placed after A Guide to the Dragon World.

landmarks.name: Tsetse Hive
landmarks.blurb: One of the nine treestuff Hives, linked to its neighbours by silk bridges.

landmarks.name: Yellowjacket Hive
landmarks.blurb: One of the nine treestuff Hives, linked to its neighbours by silk bridges.

landmarks.name: Wasp Hive
landmarks.blurb: The largest and oldest Hive, seat of Queen Wasp.

landmarks.name: Vinegaroon Hive
landmarks.blurb: One of the nine treestuff Hives, linked to its neighbours by silk bridges.

landmarks.name: Jewel Hive
landmarks.blurb: Once Lady Jewel’s Hive; its SilkWings planned to flee to Lake Scorpion.

landmarks.name: Hornet Hive
landmarks.blurb: One of the nine treestuff Hives, linked to its neighbours by silk bridges.

landmarks.name: Bloodworm Hive
landmarks.blurb: Once ruled by Lady Bloodworm, one of Queen Wasp’s sisters.

landmarks.name: Cicada Hive
landmarks.blurb: Blue’s home Hive, in the south-west of the ring.

landmarks.name: Mantis Hive
landmarks.blurb: One of the nine treestuff Hives, linked to its neighbours by silk bridges.

landmarks.name: Beetle Lake
landmarks.blurb: A large lake on the western “wing” of Pantala.

landmarks.name: Lake Scorpion
landmarks.blurb: The scorpion-shaped lake of the Dragontail Peninsula.

landmarks.name: Dragonfly Bay
landmarks.blurb: East-coast bay where a kraken lived for one rainy season.

landmarks.name: The Abyss
landmarks.blurb: A pit beneath Lake Scorpion that once held the othermind.

landmarks.name: The Sinkhole
landmarks.blurb: A pit in the savanna between the Hives where Blue, Cricket and Swordtail hid.

landmarks.name: Eye of the Jungle
landmarks.blurb: A pool on the northern edge of the Poison Jungle.

landmarks.name: Den of Vipers
landmarks.blurb: A dangerous hollow deep in the Poison Jungle.

landmarks.name: SapWing Village
landmarks.blurb: Home of the SapWing LeafWings, hidden in the jungle canopy.
